lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，举起战斧前行。
注视着你，随时准备进攻。
举着蘑菇木旗，踏过菌丝。
lines.en: He strides over mycelium behind a mushroom-wood banner.

lines.zh: 肩上驮着两捆供奉的蘑菇。
lines.en: Two bundles of offerings ride on his shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的目光越过你，数你的退路。
lines.en: My gaze passes over you, counting your escape routes.

lines.zh: 再打一下，我就喊来整队人。
lines.en: One more hit and I call the whole coven.
Hmph, those who hurt me must die!
Hold a little longer; reinforcements come.

lines.zh: 我吹响骨哨，菌柱后有人应了。
lines.en: I blow the bone whistle; someone answers behind the mushroom pillar.

lines.zh: 看到你我心跳加速，快跑吧！
lines.en: Your presence ignites my heart, run!

lines.zh: 贪心能让你得到更多，但也会带来危险。
lines.en: Greed can give you more, but also danger.

lines.zh: 不要靠近，我身上有致命的魔法。
你不能吃我，我会让你后悔的。
lines.en: You can’t eat me, you’ll regret it.

lines.zh: 看着我，你很快就会失去理智。
lines.en: Look at me, you’ll soon lose your mind.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛会被我的力量迷住。
lines.en: My power will blind your eyes.

lines.zh: 不要试图挑战我，你会失败的。
lines.en: Challenge me, and you will fail.

lines.zh: 诱惑让你靠近，但我会毁灭你。
lines.en: Lure you in, but I’ll destroy you.

lines.zh: 靠近我，你将陷入无尽的诅咒。
lines.en: Come near, and you’ll be cursed.

lines.zh: 贪婪会指引你走向死亡。
lines.en: Greed will guide you to death.
Get out of my way, or I’ll tear you!

lines.zh: 别想挡住我，我会打败你。
lines.en: Don’t try to stop me, I’ll defeat you.

lines.zh: 用盾牌挡不住我的力量。
你挡得住我，但挡不住恐惧。
lines.en: You can block me, but not fear.

lines.zh: 你挡不住我，只会自取灭亡。
lines.en: You can’t stop me, just die.

lines.zh: 再靠一步，真菌平原的旗也护不住你。
lines.en: One more step, and no fungal-plains banner saves you.

lines.zh: 援军没来，我先护住旗帜。
lines.en: No reinforcements; I guard the banner first.
Mate with me, you’ll be stronger.

lines.zh: 加入我，一起统治这个邪教。
lines.en: Join me, rule the cult together.

lines.zh: 与我合作，我们会变得更强。
lines.en: Work with me, we’ll be stronger.
Come close, I’ll teach you everything.

lines.zh: 与我一起，你会找到力量。
我的力量会融入你体内。
lines.en: My power will flow into you.

lines.zh: 靠近我，我们会共同强大。
lines.en: Come close, we’ll be powerful together.

lines.zh: 与我结合，你会获得力量。
lines.en: Mate with me, you’ll gain power.

lines.zh: 与我结合，你将成为我的伴侣。
lines.en: Mate with me, you’ll be my partner.

lines.zh: 我需要金子来购买忠诚！
lines.en: I need gold to buy loyalty!

lines.zh: 去挖矿，那里有我的财宝！
lines.en: Dig there, where my treasures lie!
Gold grains are my trade medium!

lines.zh: 邪教徒旗帜下摆，力量之源！
lines.en: The banner is the source of power!

lines.zh: 矿工们，快点！金子在等着！
邪教徒信仰的力量是无敌的！
lines.en: The power of the cult is invincible!

lines.zh: 金锭是交易的重要货币！
lines.en: Gold ingots are key to trade!

lines.zh: 你无法战胜我，邪教之子！
lines.en: You cannot defeat me, son of the cult!

lines.zh: 攻击者近了，快召唤援军！
lines.en: The attacker is near, summon reinforcements!

lines.zh: 邪教之主，守护我们的信仰！
邪教徒的旗帜下是我们的力量！
lines.en: Our power lies under the cult banner!
Cult leader, you will be defeated!

lines.zh: 邪教徒信仰的力量将毁灭你！
lines.en: The power of the cult will destroy you!

lines.zh: 邪教之子，展示你的勇气！
lines.en: Son of the cult, show your courage!

lines.zh: 邪教之主，战斗到最后一刻！
lines.en: Cult leader, fight until the end!
The fungal plains don't welcome you.
I count to three, then I call the others.

lines.zh: 你身上没有金子的味道。
邪教之子，你们将被消灭！
lines.en: Cult children, you will be destroyed!
Cult leader, let the battle begin!

lines.zh: 邪教之子，服从你的命运！
lines.en: Cult children, submit to your fate!

lines.zh: 邪教徒旗帜下，无处可逃！
lines.en: The cult banner is your only fate!

lines.zh: 邪教之主，你的时代结束了！
lines.en: Cult leader, your era is over!

lines.zh: 邪教之子，你们是我们的！
邪教之子，展现你的力量！
我的信徒就在菌柱后面。
lines.en: My faithful wait behind the fungal pillars.
Strike fast, or it's too late.
The banner falls, they all come.
You cut me, not the faith.
One claw out, and reinforcements arrive.

lines.zh: 再近一步，我的援军就到。
lines.en: One step closer and my reinforcements come.
The fury of the cult burns!
An offering to the fungal lord!
This swing is for my followers.
A figure steps out from under the cap.
I brought a whole band of the faithful.

lines.zh: 火舌舔上我的肩，信徒会闻到的。
lines.en: Flame licks my shoulder; my followers will smell it.
I fell from the fungal pillar.

lines.zh: 下界的岩浆里没处呼吸。
lines.en: Nowhere to breathe in the Nether lava.

lines.zh: 我一受伤，就会喊来同伴。
lines.en: One wound and I call my kin.

lines.zh: 这咒语违背真菌之主的意。
lines.en: That spell defies the fungal lord.
